title: Commentary on 76.2
content: Prior to taking the EiC role with BioScience, I was an avid reader of its content. I enjoyed the high-elevation perspective of what is “running under the hood,” those programs and long-term research activities that provide insight on not only the foundational aspects of our disciplines but also how science and policy are conducted and implemented, or should be, in an optimal world. We like to believe that we have maintained those strengths in our content. Many of the articles in this issue are devoted to research, education, and policy related to the conservation of biodiversity. And within, we have some fun content, including a discussion on how sports branding can contribute to the public’s appreciation of biodiversity, as well as an article that focuses on drivers of high biodiversity in subterranean ecosystems…just the sort of issue that one can sit back with and be simultaneously educated and entertained. Enjoy!
